summary: Signup now creates a new tenant per verified signup, with the user as owner (tenant named from the email domain, or "<Name>'s Workspace" for free-mail), written atomically via Database::transaction() and swappable via the SignupTenantResolver policy point. Adds opt-in, server-side Terms & Conditions acceptance at signup ($config['signup']['require_terms']), recording UTC acceptance time + terms version on users (new columns; existing installs run sql/migrations/v2.1.0_signup_terms.sql before enabling). Signup auto-login now records the login. Full detail in CHANGELOG.md [2.1.0].

database_changes.migration: sql/migrations/v2.1.0_signup_terms.sql (idempotent; existing installs only; notes in Versions/FrankPHP_v2.1.0_migration_notes.md)

breaking_changes: Behaviour: every new signup now creates its own tenant and becomes its owner (previously joined tenant 1 as user). Apps needing another model must override SignupTenantResolver in app/bootstrap.php before deploying.
ai_notes: schema-signals.json tracks tables and ALTER statements in schema.core.sql only, so the four new columns appear under database_changes.columns_added, not in the generated signals.
Code is safe on un-migrated installs while signup.require_terms is off; with the flag on and columns missing, signup routes throw a LogicException naming the migration.
Starter app/ changes (signup view checkbox, verify view no auto-submit, /terms placeholder, legal.php removed) are application-owned and not in this framework manifest.
